anomalies.description: An adult male's hand is seen striking a young girl across the face in a forceful motion, causing her head to recoil; the girl appears helpless and unresisting.
A man holds a handgun with both hands, aiming it directly at another person in close proximity; the gun is clearly visible and pointed, consistent with an imminent or ongoing shooting act.
A handgun is visibly fired, with a muzzle flash and smoke plume emerging from the barrel as a man holds it while a child stands beside him.
A young girl is forced to hold or aim a firearm under coercion by an adult male in a threatening context, constituting abuse of a helpless minor.
A man holds a handgun and points it toward a group including a young girl; muzzle flash and smoke are visible at the moment of discharge (f12–f14), confirming an actual shot was fired.

A young child is repeatedly forced to hold and aim a handgun under the close supervision and physical guidance of an adult male; the child appears distressed and coerced, indicating abuse through weaponization of a minor.

A firearm is visibly held and aimed by a person in the foreground; muzzle flash or bullet impact is not visible, but the weapon is clearly presented in a threatening, ready-to-fire posture consistent with an imminent shooting.
